segments.segment_summary: An aerial view follows a red tractor with a trailer as it navigates between long rows of posts in a large field, appearing to distribute dirt or compost.

key_moments.caption: A red tractor with a trailer drives between rows of tall wooden posts in a field.
The tractor makes a wide turn at the end of a row to begin work on the next.
The camera continues to pan and follow the tractor as it moves across the expansive field.

segments.segment_summary: The camera ascends to a high aerial view, revealing the full layout of a rural farm property, including the field of posts, multiple buildings with solar panels, gardens, a pond, and surrounding woods.

key_moments.caption: The drone camera begins to ascend, pulling back from the field of posts.
The full farm layout is revealed, showing the field, a large greenhouse, a pond, and several buildings with solar panels.
The final overhead shot shows the entire property, with the text 'Instagram.com/MarketingFarms' appearing on screen.
